Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207(1), an order confirmation expressly conditional on the new loading charge is a counteroffer, and nothing shows that counteroffer was accepted.

Q8260.reason: Water is formed only when O2 accepts electrons at complex IV, so it stops at once, while glycolysis still makes pyruvate and some ATP.

Q5585.reason: The question is leading on direct examination of the calling party’s own non-adverse witness, so the objection should be sustained.
